prompt: Print a solid rectangle of '*' characters with nested loops and println. Complete the printBox method; the tests capture and compare everything you print.
explanation: Nested loops map naturally onto a grid: the outer loop runs once per line and the inner loop builds each line character by character. Building the line in a StringBuilder and printing it with one println keeps exactly one line separator per row. The tests capture System.out, so what matters is the exact text printed, including the newline after every row.
hints: Use an outer loop that runs height times -- one iteration per printed line.
Inside it, build a string of width '*' characters (a StringBuilder or "*".repeat(width) both work).
Print each finished line with System.out.println so every row ends with a line separator.
